# Logo

The Payset wordmark, from the brand's own SVG files.

`PaysetWeb.Logo` · Brand

## Use

```jsx
<PaysetWeb.Logo />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PaysetWeb.Logo"></x-import>
```

## Props (LogoProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onDark` | `boolean` | true: white file · false: money-green file · omitted: follows the theme |
| `height` | `number` | Height in px, default 28, minimum 20. |
